notes: status: review|approved|rejected (skink52 reviews every frame by hand, docs/FRAME_REVIEW.md); tools/frames.py writes only approved frames into models.json unless --all. Source models for the frames in parts.json (model key -> where it comes from and how to convert it). Workshop items are downloaded with SteamCMD (app 4000, anonymous), extracted with create/playermodels/gma.py, converted with create/mdl2cs2.py by tools/frames.py. 'mdl' paths are inside the extracted item; 'parts' lists extra .mdl files (weapons, back units) converted as weapon props. 'permission': 'asked' / 'granted' / 'none' (none = private servers only; the Workshop description lists every port and its author). 'height' is the class height the model is scaled to (parts.json classes). 'legs' is the bone-name regex that selects the legs prop (everything else is the upper body); null = hover-only frame, no split. Tripo frames (source 'tripo'): 'glb' is a rigged GLB from Tripo AI converted by create/glbrig.py through mdl2cs2 (Mixamo bones renamed to ValveBiped), 'decimate' = LOD0 triangle target, 'retint' = pull toward the roster palette (hardsurface_mat.py).
